best_idea: A target lock that sticks to the last foe you hit for a fixed window (10 s by default), refreshed on each hit, and falls back to the nearest foe in range when it lapses; the frame bar keeps a 1 px minimum so a nearly dead foe stays visible.
decision_why: Take the sticky last-hit lock with a timed window and nearest fallback, refresh the window on each hit (the donor does not), keep the 1 px bar minimum; leave the mouse one-shot rule for the touch and pointer decision.
acceptance: Keyboard or gamepad in a 3-foe fight: hit foe A at 0 s and again at 9 s; A stays on the frame until 19 s, then the nearest foe in range takes the frame; a server test asserts the engine target is A at 18.9 s and the nearest foe at 19.0 s.
